No. The land-change method could not evaluate ASSET-J. The source coverage this asset needs had not been prepared, so no observation was made. Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020 and MGAP 2021 were all unavailable for it.

The claim was tree-cover loss within the asset boundary after the 2020-12-31 baseline, for 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31. The result is "insufficient evidence because of missing coverage."

This means the evidence says nothing either way. It does not show that no tree-cover loss occurred, and it does not show that loss occurred. It also supports no regulatory or compliance finding, such as EUDR compliant, non-compliant or deforestation-free.

To get an answer, the missing source coverage would need to be prepared and the assessment rerun. This reflects what was known as of 2026-11-12.
